not_authorized: any rescoring of the sealed R1 bank
scope.forbidden_language: stage 2 is a validation pilot. No stage-2 number may be reported as a held-out result, and no stage-2 selection may be described as confirmation

split_rule.selection: hyperparameters are chosen here and nowhere else
split_rule.pilot: the reported stage-2 endpoint is computed here, on truths no hyperparameter ever saw
split_rule.disjointness: by construction -- the two splits derive from different commitment strings, so no truth seed can appear in both. Gate R1L_S2_G3 re-checks it by content hash at run time rather than trusting the construction
split_rule.commitment_meaning: sha256 over (bank, family, split, n, seed). The runner derives every truth seed from the same string and must reproduce the hash before scoring

constant_flux_structural.construction: each age slice renormalized to a fixed spatial mean, so total-level variation is removed and moving morphology is retained

structure_balanced_050.construction: j = b(t) + s(r, phi, t) with b the minimum baseline that keeps j non-negative at the target fraction

structure_balanced_080.construction: as above at the higher fraction

baseline_one_positive.rule: may not carry the primary endpoint

source_balance_tolerances.structure_fraction_rule: ||P_structure j|| / ||j|| must fall within this of the target for every truth in a structure-balanced bank that is not at its positivity ceiling
source_balance_tolerances.constant_flux_rule: the spatial mean of every age slice must be constant to this relative tolerance
source_balance_tolerances.positivity_rule: min over the rendered movie must be at or above zero

positivity_ceiling.fact: a non-negative field cannot have an arbitrary structure fraction. Writing j = s + c, positivity forces c >= -min(s), and the fraction ||s||/||s+c|| falls monotonically in c, so the maximum is ||s|| / ||s - min(s)||, reached exactly at the positivity boundary. Scaling does not evade it: at the boundary j = a(s - min s) for any a > 0 and the fraction is unchanged

measured_before_freezing.what: the ceiling per family, over 20 draws each, on the declared evaluation grid and the R0C level projector
measured_before_freezing.why_this_is_not_peeking: the ceiling is a property of the source family and the projector alone. No operator, arm, estimator, noise draw or reconstruction enters it, so it cannot be a result and cannot be selected on. It is measured here because declaring an unreachable target and calling the shortfall a finding would be worse

positivity_ceiling.handling: a truth whose target exceeds its ceiling is kept at the ceiling -- the most structural non-negative field of that shape -- and flagged at_positivity_ceiling. It is not discarded and the bank is not silently retargeted

bank_construction_failure.rule: a structure-balanced bank in which fewer than half the truths reach their declared target within 0.02 is a construction failure and dispositions R1L_STAGE2_SOURCE_BANK_FAILURE

baseline_dominance.rule: R1L_STOP_4 trips when a primary bank's median achieved structure fraction falls below this, i.e. a level fraction above 0.94, which is the regime R1 was in at 0.126 structure and 0.992 level
baseline_dominance.note: an earlier draft of this freeze set a ceiling of 0.60 on the *level* fraction. That was mis-specified: a structure fraction of 0.50 implies a level fraction of sqrt(1 - 0.25) = 0.866, so the reviewer's own primary target would have tripped its own failure condition. Corrected before any truth was generated

plunging_family.orbit_law: radial plunge on the ISCO's conserved E and L

velocity_field_for_g3.inside_isco: radial plunge on the ISCO's conserved E and L, Omega = u^phi / u^t
velocity_field_for_g3.raymap_fluid_note: AART gfactorf called with betaphi = betar = sub_kep = 1, i.e. fully Keplerian outside the ISCO and plunging inside it, which is the same field
velocity_field_for_g3.superseded_law: Omega = r^{-3/2}, Newtonian, used by the R0/R1 families; retained there because those banks are sealed and reported

estimators.selection_rule: lexicographic on the selection split, minimizing old-band structure error at SNR0 = 100, ties broken by the smaller model. Selected per (class, arm, estimator) and frozen before the pilot split is touched
estimators.no_retuning: no hyperparameter may be revisited after any pilot truth is scored

noise.coupling: one resolved Gaussian draw per (truth, draw index); direct, unresolved and total flux are the declared linear readouts of that same draw, so the arms are paired
noise.independent_unit: the truth, not the truth-noise pair

success_requires: lower old-band structure error in at least three of the four fitting families
confirmation by both TSVD and RIDGE_IDENTITY

coprimary_endpoint.if_only_at_30000: reported as a negative practicality result

unresolved_arm_rule: UNRESOLVED_IMAGE is reported at the same standing as RESOLVED_PHYSICAL. A gain that appears only in the resolved arm is an ideal channel-separation result and is dispositioned R1L_STAGE2_RESOLVED_ONLY_PASS, not a pass
required_outputs: a proposed sealed-main commitment, not scored

sealed_main_commitment.rule: stage 2 proposes the sealed-main bank and commits its hash. It must not be generated through any operator, inspected or scored in stage 2

resource_limits.on_exceeded: R1L_STAGE2_IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT. The run stops and reports; it does not silently reduce counts, drop a class or subsample a bank to fit
resource_limits.no_silent_reduction: any reduction in the declared counts is a protocol deviation and must be recorded as one

numerical_environment.assertion: every BLAS pool must report one thread, interrogated after import. Gate R1L_S2_G1

dispositions.R1L_STAGE2_RESOLVED_AND_UNRESOLVED_PASS: the primary endpoint succeeds on all four criteria for the resolved arm and the unresolved arm also shows a bootstrap interval excluding zero at SNR0 = 100
dispositions.R1L_STAGE2_RESOLVED_ONLY_PASS: the primary endpoint succeeds for the resolved arm and the unresolved arm does not
dispositions.R1L_STAGE2_NEGATIVE_RESULT: the banks are sound and the endpoint does not succeed for the resolved arm. This is a reportable result and is not a reason to widen the design
dispositions.R1L_STAGE2_SOURCE_BANK_FAILURE: a declared bank could not be constructed within the source-balance tolerances, so the endpoint was never testable
dispositions.R1L_STAGE2_IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT: a gate failed, a resource limit was exceeded, or a split commitment did not reproduce

attestation.rule: scoped to registered paths: source, scripts, configs, tests, schemas and artifacts/configs. Generated artifacts elsewhere do not make a run unattested; an uncommitted freeze does
